body:
# ADVO
WEB DEVELOPMENT SERVICES

**{{client_name}}**

**Date:** {{contract_date}}

## Summary
- This contract is between **{{client_name}}** and **ADVO Web Development Services** regarding the development, delivery, and hosting of the {{application_name}}, a single application composed of {{system_count}} independent business systems.
- The Client selects which systems to commission. Each system is priced, built, tested, and delivered on its own. The Client may commission the remaining systems at any later date at the rates fixed in this contract.

## Scope of Work
**WEB DEVELOPMENT DELIVERABLES**
**{{application_name}}**
{{#each system}}
- **{{system_number}}. {{system_name}}**
  {{system_feature_list}}
{{/each}}

**INCLUDED WITH EVERY SYSTEM**
- Mobile Application (Android/iOS), Roles & Permissions, Notifications, Audit Trail, and Multi-Company Support.

## Investment Packages
| SYSTEM | FEE | SELECT |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
{{#each system}}| {{system_name}} | ₱{{system_fee}} | [ ] |
{{/each}}| **ALL SYSTEMS** | **₱{{total_fee}}** | [ ] |

- Rates are fixed for {{rate_lock_month_count}} months
- Only the systems initialled above are commissioned and billed. The Client may commission the remaining systems in any order, at any time.
- **Future Systems:** To be billed at pre-agreed module prices upon written activation.

## Contract Length
- This contract covers the design and development of each system the Client commissions, until final delivery and sign-off.
- The estimated development timeline is {{timeline_per_system}} per system, and {{timeline_largest_system}} for {{largest_system_name}}, counted from receipt of down payment.
- Delays caused by the client (late assets, delayed feedback, or no response within {{client_no_response_day_count}} calendar days) automatically extend the timeline by the equivalent number of days without penalty to ADVO.
- In the case that complementary revisions are not yet utilized on the delivery date of the final product, {{client_name}} may still invoke these revisions as needed to the scope aforementioned, only up until {{post_signoff_revision_window_month_count}} months after signing the “Project Sign-off” document.
- The pricing structure and fees are open to negotiation upon further discussion between both parties.

## Payment
**Per-System Payment Schedule**
| MILESTONE | TRIGGER | AMOUNT |
| :-: | :-: | :-: |
| DOWNPAYMENT ({{downpayment_pct}}%) | Upon commissioning of that system. | {{downpayment_pct}}% of fee |
| FINAL PAYMENT ({{final_payment_pct}}%) | Final delivery and sign-off. | {{final_payment_pct}}% of fee |

- Invoices are payable within {{invoice_due_business_day_count}} business days of issuance.
- Unpaid balances remaining after fifteen (15) business days from the date of issuance (commencing strictly on the 16th business day) shall incur a penalty fee of {{late_penalty_pct_per_month}}% per month, calculated daily until fully settled.
- Payment is due and payable upon signing of the “Project Sign-off” document. Clients are given seven (7) days from signing to comply with payment dues.
- After the application is completed, {{client_name}} is required to pay the amount that is associated with that build.

**Referral Incentive — {{referral_product_name}}:**
- The Client may earn a {{referral_meeting_discount_pct}}% discount for a meeting referral or a {{referral_signed_contract_discount_pct}}% discount if the referred operator signs a contract for {{referral_product_name}}.

## Ongoing Hosting, Infrastructure & Data Retention
- The Total Fee covers the design and development of the application. It does not cover the ongoing costs required to keep the database and application live on the internet.
- **Monthly Infrastructure Fee:** Upon final delivery and deployment of the {{infra_trigger_system_name}}, the Client agrees to a recurring monthly infrastructure fee of **₱{{infra_fee_per_month}}**. This fee is billed on the 1st of every month.
- **Infrastructure Inclusions:** Maintenance (New features, development updates, bug fixes), web hosting, database, and domain renewals.
- **Data Retention:** The system architecture supports a {{data_retention_year_count}}-year data retention policy. Data exceeding {{data_retention_year_count}} years of age will be subject to automated backup and archival/deletion workflows to maintain system performance.
- *If the monthly infrastructure fee is not paid within 15 days of the due date, ADVO reserves the right to suspend server hosting and API access until the balance is cleared, resulting in the application going offline. The developer shall not be held liable for any data loss or business interruption resulting from this suspension.*
- The client may continue with ADVO-managed hosting and maintenance, or request a system transfer to their own hosting provider after full payment.

## Intellectual Property & Ownership
- ***IP Retention until full payment:*** All design files, source code, and deliverables remain the exclusive property of ADVO until full payment is received. The Client has no right to publish or use any deliverable until the corresponding payment clears.
- ***Client-provided assets:*** For product shots, establishment photos, or brand materials, ADVO is granted a limited license to use them solely for the purpose of building the application.
- ***Data Privacy:*** All private organizational data is accessible only by the client and will remain strictly confidential.
- ***Transfer upon full payment:*** Full ownership of all deliverables transfers to the Client upon receipt of final payment, including source files and codebases.
- ***Portfolio rights:*** ADVO retains the right to display completed work in its portfolio and marketing materials unless the Client requests otherwise in writing before final delivery.

## Non-Abandonment & Project Continuity
- Protects both parties from project abandonment and ensures continuity of work
- ***ADVO's Commitment***: ADVO will not unilaterally abandon or deprioritize this project in favor of another engagement without prior written notice.
- ***Client's Commitment***: The Client may not cease communication, withhold payment, or engage a third party to replicate or replace ADVO's work while the project is active and any payment is outstanding. Doing so constitutes a material breach of this contract.
- ***Termination With Cause***: Either party may rescind this contract with legitimate cause by issuing a written notice and allowing a 14-day cure period to resolve the issue. The Client remains liable for the financial value of all work completed up to the date of termination.
- ***Termination Without Cause (Client)***: Upon cancellation of the contract mid-project by the client due to convenience, the client must compensate the developer for the exact percentage of project completion achieved up to the cancellation date, alongside fully reimbursing any non-refundable third-party integrations purchased for the project.
- ***Termination Without Cause (ADVO)***: ADVO fully refunds any advanced milestones for which work has not yet commenced and surrenders all paid-for code assets to the client in their current state.

## Revisions & Scope Management
- Each deliverable permits up to {{revision_round_count}} ROUNDS OF REVISIONS at no additional cost. Revisions may be utilized until after the “Project Sign-Off” document is signed. All design revisions must be utilized prior to the final Project Sign-off. Post-launch adjustments fall strictly under the MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.
- New modules, redesigns, or feature additions are change requests and require a written addendum before work begins. Redesigns or structural adjustments exceeding this scope will require a separate change order addendum.
- **Notice of Deemed Approval:** If the Client fails to provide feedback within {{deemed_approval_notice_business_day_count}} business days, a Notice of Pending Deemed Approval is issued. Revisions are deemed approved after {{deemed_approval_day_count}} subsequent days of non-response.
- While ADVO commits to exercising professional diligence in project execution, it shall not be held liable for indirect commercial losses, third-party service interruptions, or events arising from forces beyond its reasonable control.

## Exemptions from liability
**Fortuitous Events:** Neither party shall be held legally responsible for delays, defects, or failure to perform obligations under this agreement resulting from Fortuitous Events, including acts of God, national connectivity outages, changes to regional regulations, and prolonged server outages beyond the reasonable control of the developer. In such circumstances, performance timelines are paused for the duration of the event.

**Third-Party Service Dependencies:** The developer is not responsible for the performance, uptime, or service availability of third-party platforms (e.g., {{third_party_dependency_list}}). Liability for outages or failures of these external services remains with the respective third-party providers.

## Signatures
By signing below, both parties confirm they have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of this contract.

Reviewed and approved by:

ADVO Web Development Services   Signature/Date
Printed Name

- WHEREAS, the parties wish to clarify and establish the separate ongoing maintenance terms for {{component_name}} to ensure its continuous operation.

# 3. CLARIFICATION OF PAYMENT TERMS

Both parties hereby agree to the following terms and additions:
- **Final Balance Due:** The client shall remit the remaining balance of ₱{{balance_due}} prior to the complete transfer of ownership, source files, and codebases, completing the ₱{{total_fee}} total project investment.
- **{{component_name}} Maintenance Fee:** To support the continuous operation and API requirements of {{component_name}}, a separate maintenance fee of ₱{{component_maintenance_fee_per_month}} per month will apply. This fee shall commence {{component_maintenance_start}} after the complete transfer of ownership, source files, and codebases.
- **General Website Maintenance:** As stipulated in the Original Agreement, the first year of general website operation remains free of maintenance charges. Upon the conclusion of the first year (12 months), the Client shall be subject to the standard annual maintenance fee of **{{maintenance_fee_per_year}} PHP**.

# 4. CONTINUITY OF ORIGINAL AGREEMENT

Except as expressly modified by this Addendum, all other terms, conditions, and provisions of the Original Agreement shall remain in full force and effect. In the event of any conflict between the terms of the Original Agreement and this Addendum, the terms of this Addendum shall prevail.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Addendum as of the date first above written.

name: Nine-slide business pitch script
body:
# PITCH

## SLIDE 1 — WHAT IS ADVO
**Speaker: {{speaker_ceo}}**
- Hello! We're ADVO. We're a web development company. We build web apps and websites for businesses that want to modernize how they operate or how they show up online.
- Objection: there are so many developers out there already. It's not just about making something that looks good; what businesses actually need is something that works, solves a real problem, that their staff can actually use and that gets real results. Most developers just build and leave.
- ADVO builds with purpose. Every product is designed around what the business actually needs, and we use AI-assisted development to deliver it faster and at a higher standard than traditional development allows.
- Bridge: before how we do it, here is who needs this — the scale of the problem in the Philippines makes the opportunity clear.

## SLIDE 2 — CLIENTS WHO NEED INTERNAL SYSTEMS
**Speaker: {{speaker_ceo}}**
- Two types of clients. First: businesses that need to fix how they operate internally.
- Vignette 1: {{internal_vignette_1}} (default: a mid-sized clinic on paper records, no data, everything manual and slow).
- Vignette 2: {{internal_vignette_2}} (default: a construction company running five projects across group chats and printed documents).
- Vignette 3: {{internal_vignette_3}} (default: a manufacturer logging production by hand, reports reaching management a week late).
- This is the everyday reality for hundreds of businesses across the Philippines. They know they need a system; they haven't found the right partner to build it.

## SLIDE 3 — CLIENTS WHO NEED EXTERNAL PRESENCE
**Speaker: {{speaker_ceo}}**
- Second type: businesses that need to grow their presence and reach customers online.
- How many Philippine businesses still have no website, or one built five years ago that does nothing. A visitor lands, can't find what they need, leaves. No inquiry, no sale.
- Examples: {{external_example_list}} (default: a windows and doors company, a local restaurant, a service business, a developer).
- In {{current_year}}, your website is your first impression, and most businesses in the Philippines are still making a bad one or none at all.
- "Andaming ganito." Thousands of businesses in one or both situations, ready to change. They just need the right team. That's what ADVO is for.

## SLIDE 4 — HOW WE BUILD IT
**Speaker: {{speaker_lead_developer}}**
- I'm {{speaker_lead_developer}}, ADVO's lead developer. This is what makes us different.
- Traditional development is slow: a standard agency takes {{traditional_agency_timeline}} to deliver; everything manual, large team, heavy process, all passed on to the client.
- ADVO uses AI-assisted development: AI handles the repetitive, time-consuming parts so developers focus on expertise and judgment. A project that took months now takes weeks, and quality improves because AI catches issues early.
- This is how the best teams in the world work now; we apply it here for Philippine businesses.
- Proof: right now I'm actively building {{live_project_name}} for {{live_project_client}}. It's in development as we speak.

## SLIDE 5 — PROOF / ACTIVE PROJECTS
**Speaker: {{speaker_ceo}}**
- Not projections. Active work.
- Project 1: {{proof_project_1_client}} — {{proof_project_1_description}} (default: a lead-generation, search-optimized website with a Smart Quote system that routes every visitor quote request to the sales team). Live in development right now.
- Project 2 (personally led by {{speaker_ceo}}): {{proof_project_2_client}} — {{proof_project_2_description}} (default: a Medical Registry Application for a hospital section, starting with one disease; connects to the EMR, extracts and categorizes patient data into a structured template, AI double-checks, doctor reviews and signs off; no encoder needed).
- The problem it solves: {{proof_project_2_problem}}. Expansion path: {{proof_project_2_expansion}} (other diseases, sections, hospitals; a standard tool nationwide).
- That's the kind of work we do, and we're doing it right now.

## SLIDE 6 — WHO WE'RE BUILT FOR
**Speaker: {{speaker_project_manager_1}}**
- I'm {{speaker_project_manager_1}}, one of ADVO's project managers: on-time delivery and the client always knowing where things stand.
- Target 1: construction companies — enormous complexity, multiple projects, contractors, materials, timelines, approvals, budgets; when projects are worth {{construction_project_value}}, a proper workflow system pays for itself fast.
- Target 2: healthcare — private clinics, specialty practices, hospitals; records, scheduling, workflows, registries; {{proof_project_2_client}} is proof we can do it.
- Target 3: government-adjacent organizations and offices managing large-scale public data.
- Beyond those: any business still on paper or disconnected tools. If someone in your network runs one, we want to talk to them.
- Not one-time projects: long-term partnerships where we build, maintain and grow the system with the business.

## SLIDE 7 — THE TEAM
**Speaker: {{speaker_project_manager_2}}**
- Every project is backed by a full team: not just developers, but people managing timelines, client relationships, finances and growth.
- I'm {{speaker_project_manager_2}}, project manager alongside {{speaker_project_manager_1}}; we keep projects moving and nothing falls through the cracks.
- {{speaker_ceo}} — CEO and founder; leads direction and oversees every product.
- {{speaker_lead_developer}} — lead developer; builds the core of every system.
- {{speaker_finance}} — finances and operations.
- {{growth_lead_name}} — growth and partnerships lead; the reason we're in rooms like this one.

## SLIDE 8 — FINANCES & TRUST
**Speaker: {{speaker_finance}}**
- I'm {{speaker_finance}}; I handle ADVO's finances and operations. How do we handle money?
- Every project starts with a clear written agreement: full scope, deliverables, timeline, payment structure. No surprises, no unexpected invoice.
- Milestone-based payment: a downpayment to begin, the balance tied to delivery. The client pays as we prove the work.
- Pricing: quotes scoped to the project and adjusted to budget; the client knows the number before signing and it doesn't change without their approval.
- Internally: full records of every expense, every tool, hosting cost and third-party service tied to a project or operational need. We run lean so most of every payment goes into the work.
- Contracts: every engagement is covered by a formal web development agreement signed by both parties, with terms for scope, payment, IP and termination. Protects the client as much as us.
- We're a young company, but we built these structures from day one because we're building something clients can trust with serious work, data and money.

## SLIDE 9 — CLOSE
**Speaker: {{speaker_ceo}}**
- The Philippines has a massive digitalization gap. Businesses know it, hospitals know it, demand is real and growing. ADVO is built to meet it.
- We build fast, with intelligence, and things that last. Full team, clear structure, active clients, a path that scales from individual businesses to entire industries.
- We're not asking you to take a chance on a dream; we're showing what we already do and asking for the right introductions.
- The ask: if you know {{ask_list}} (default: a construction company that needs a system, a hospital or clinic wanting to digitalize, a business owner tired of paper), we are ready. We'd love to meet them. Thank you.
